A.evidence: Randomized real data: KuaiRand random exposures, Hillstrom, Criteo
A.supports: A component ranks or targets better in that domain
A.cannot: Anything about push, fatigue or long-term effects

B.evidence: Off-policy estimate on real logs from an estimator first validated against a known answer
B.supports: The value of a new policy within the support of the logging policy
B.cannot: Policies outside that support; long horizons

C.evidence: Simulator runs with a sensitivity sweep
C.supports: Policy A beats B across a stated share of assumptions, or flips at a stated threshold

descriptive.evidence: Counts of a fixed set, no inference
